newsitem.title: USA: USDA's Glickman to meet with black farmers.
newsitem.headline: USDA's Glickman to meet with black farmers.

text.p: Agriculture Secretary Dan Glickman will meet Thursday afternoon with a group of black U.S. farmers to discuss charges of a pattern of discrimination in farm lending by the Agriculture Department.

Glickman said Tuesday he had instructed the department's Office of Inspector General to investigate the status of discrimination complaints against the Farm Service Agency and to recommend a plan for resolving them.

Black producers have long complained that they were not treated fairly in USDA farmer loan programs, alleging among other things, that their loan applications are not processed as swiftly as those of white farmers.
A group of minority farmers have planned a protest in Washington on Thursday.
Glickman told a meeting of USDA agency heads Thursday that following civil rights rules is the highest priority at the department.
